findings.title: Issue detail endpoint is repo-agnostic, so the panel can render another repo's snapshot for a colliding issue number
findings.description: e82239f4 scoped the client-side cache lookup (dashboard/page.tsx:221-226) and selectedIssueRepoId (492-503) to the clicked repo, and all three selection paths (176, 398, 671) do set selectedRepoId — that part is correct and complete. But dashboard/page.tsx:245 still calls fetchIssueDetail(selectedIssueNumber), which hits GET /api/v1/agent-runner/issues/{issue_number} with NO repo scope; _build_issue_detail_response (agent_runner.py:331-356) iterates registered repos and returns the FIRST one carrying that number. When the selected repo's ready-slot snapshot does not contain the number (a poll transitions that slot to error/missing, or the runner churns its labels between the click and the effect), the condition at line 238 also fails, so the panel displays another repo's monitoring detail (PR/worktree/anomalies) while labels and actions are sent to the clicked repo. The registry in the screenshots has 3 repos, so collisions are possible. Root cause is pre-existing, but FR-5 and FR-6 (recover_failed_publish) newly put write controls on that panel; there is no automated regression net (frontend-public has no unit runner, tests/playwright-e2e has no console dashboard coverage), so this class of defect is caught only by human clicking.

findings.title: Three endpoint paths in the new docs table do not exist in the router
findings.description: The table '网页操作入口与对应端点（CLI 能力对齐）' added by this PR is the operator-facing map for the new capability, and three of its rows are wrong versus the routes I enumerated from the live app: 3757 'POST .../console/actions/repository' is actually POST /api/v1/agent-runner/console/repositories/{repo_id}/actions; 3761 'POST .../console/actions/issue' is actually POST /api/v1/agent-runner/console/repositories/{repo_id}/issues/{issue_number}/actions; 3762 'POST .../console/backlog/.../enqueue-ready' is actually POST /api/v1/agent-runner/backlog/prds/{encoded_path}/enqueue-ready (there is no 'console' segment). An operator following the doc will 404. The other five rows are accurate.

findings.title: Evidence scripts report green pytest exit but do not fail on it; one capture script is stale
findings.description: rv-3/4/6/7 append '[green-exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}]' to the log without exiting non-zero on failure, so a future re-run whose pytest step regresses still exits 0 — the green claim survives only because evidence.json's stdout assertions (e.g. '5 passed') would miss. Separately, capture_ui_screenshots.mjs:116 hard-waits for the 加入就绪 button, which renders only for not_started PRDs, so it times out and exits 1; the rv-3 PNG actually comes from capture_backlog_screenshots.mjs (which discloses this honestly). Both are independent-verifier findings #1/#3. Neither file is tracked in git (only the three evidence .md files are), so this is evidence-tooling hygiene and shipped code is unaffected — the verifier re-checked exit codes by hand and confirmed 0, and I re-ran the underlying suites at head myself.

findings.title: system-design.md still lists a register endpoint while this PR removes registration from frontend-public
findings.description: The 认证与会话域 table lists 登录端点 '/auth/*（login/register/logout/me）' for the public domain whose 前端 is frontend-public, and states the public domain offers 开放自助注册. There is no register route anywhere in src/backend/api/routes/ (only local_auth.py), and FR-9 of this PR deliberately removes the register page precisely because that call could never succeed. Pre-existing drift in unchanged code, but it is now adjacent to a delivered change, so it may mislead the next reader about what the console actually offers.

findings.title: 「直出 PR」选项在唯一暴露它的入口上必然被 CLI 拒绝，FR-7/决定二/rv-5 的验收 oracle 无法达成
findings.description: 选项 sheet 的 direct_pr 折算成 argv `--direct-pr`（src/backend/core/shared/models/runner_launch.py:91），而 launch_options 只从 backlog start 端点流入（src/backend/api/routes/agent_runner_backlog.py:706-728），该路径 spawn 的是 `kc run --issue N --direct-pr`（src/backend/core/use_cases/console_processes.py:111）。但 `kc run --direct-pr` 对带 PRD 锚点的 Issue 是硬性 USAGE 拒绝（src/backend/api/cli_parsed_commands/runner.py:517-534），而 start_prd 建的 Issue 正文一定写有 `- PRD path: ...`（src/backend/core/use_cases/create_issue_from_prd.py:284）。结果：勾选后前端 toast「已开始」、进程页留一条立刻以用法错误退出的托管进程，永远出不了 PR。这直接违背 PRD §1 行为样例与决定二的验收（「勾选后执行结果走了对应通道」），也违背 runner_launch.py 自己声明的设计意图（「让错误在发起端就暴露成一次明确的拒绝，而不是在子进程里静默降级」）——路由预检只校验互斥/缺预设/单 token，没有覆盖 PRD 锚点与 `--all-ready` 这两条 CLI 目标域规则。证据侧同样未验证：rv-5 只断言 argv 折算，并在披露中写明「未在隔离 registry 起真实 console 实跑」，且 tests/test_console_cli_parity.py 从未对 direct_pr=True 做正例 argv 断言（仅出现在 392/411 的互斥负例），PRD §9 却把 rv-5 记为 [x]。建议：要么在 backlog start 边界即拒绝 direct_pr 并返回 CLI 同款原因（400），要么按决定二的保守档从 PRD-only sheet 移除该开关，并同步 docs 表格、§1 行为样例与 rv-5 勾选状态。

findings.title: 标签白名单含工作流状态标签与人工签收标签，一键即可写入，且未在决定一呈递范围内披露
findings.description: allowed_labels = standard_label_names 全量同步集合，其中不只「队列资格」标签：`agent/running`、`agent/supervising`、`agent/failed`、`agent/waiting`、`direct-pr`、`validation/passed`、`validation/verifier-passed` 都可写。这些是被自动化消费的：`validation/passed` 正是验证门禁读取的人工签收信号（src/backend/core/use_cases/agent_runner_validation_gate.py:66），`agent/running` 被 reclaim/claim 逻辑当作在途依据（src/backend/core/use_cases/agent_runner_reclaim.py:208,298），误写会让 daemon 跳过该 Issue 且 enqueue-ready 永久返回 409。前端把整个 allowed_labels 平铺成一个下拉、点击即写（frontend-public/components/agent-runner/issue-label-editor.tsx:141-159），无任何分级或二次确认。决定一原文只问「已同步标准集 vs 新建标签」，PRD §2 与 human-review-checklist 描述风险时也只举「拼错的 agent/redy 脱离监控口径」，因此人工是在信息不完整的情况下被要求勾第 1 项。此处不需要擅自收窄集合（收窄等于改需求），但必须把「网页可写出状态机/签收标签」写进决定一与 docs 的「标签编辑的例外」段呈给拍板人。

findings.title: 新增 Issue 写端点只审计成功路径，与文档「含被拒绝的都会写入审计日志」矛盾
findings.description: put_console_issue_labels 与 create_console_issue_from_prompt 都在 422/400 抛 HTTPException 之后才调用 _audit_issue_write，被拒的标签写入尝试（例如有人试着往 Issue 上加集合外或敏感标签）不留任何痕迹；对照既有 console 动作面是无条件落审计的（src/backend/core/use_cases/console_actions.py:254,312,323）。而 docs/guides/agent-runner.md:3747 紧接本次新增的「标签编辑的例外」段落之后仍写着「所有写操作（含被拒绝的）都会写入审计日志」。建议把拒绝分支也纳入审计，或修正该文档断言。

findings.title: from-prompt 建 Issue 的 issue_type 未做集合校验，绕过 FR-5 的标签纪律
findings.description: labels 由 f"type/{request.issue_type}" 直接拼接，请求模型只约束 min_length=1（src/backend/api/routes/agent_runner_console_issues.py:216）。FR-5 特意把标签写入收敛到 standard_label_names 且明确「网页不创建新标签」，但第二条写路径可以把任意字符串作为标签名交给 gh（前端下拉确实只给 feature/bug 等，见 create-issue-dialog.tsx:48，但服务端无防线），失败会发生在 gh 侧且报错难定位。建议按已同步的 type/* 名字校验，或收敛为受限枚举。

findings.title: RunnerLaunchOptions.is_default() 与 cli_flags() 对 agent="auto" 判定不一致
findings.description: is_default() 看的是归一后的原始值，agent="auto" 为真即判 non-default，而 cli_flags() 会跳过它返回空元组（91-98）。今天 is_default() 只被测试使用（tests/test_console_cli_parity.py:348），所以无实际影响；但一旦有人用它做「缺省契约一致」的判定，前端默认下发的 agent="auto" 就会被误判成带选项启动，埋成一个与 rv-5 结论相冲突的坑。建议让 is_default() 直接以 cli_flags() 为空作判据。
